translations.en.sahih: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
translations.en.pickthall: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
translations.en.yusufali: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
translations.id.indonesian: Sudah datangkah kepadamu berita (tentang) hari pembalasan?

translations.en.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
translations.en.pickthall: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
translations.en.yusufali: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
translations.id.indonesian: Banyak muka pada hari itu tunduk terhina,

translations.en.sahih: Working [hard] and exhausted.
translations.en.pickthall: Toiling, weary,
translations.en.yusufali: Labouring (hard), weary,-
translations.id.indonesian: bekerja keras lagi kepayahan,

translations.en.sahih: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
translations.en.pickthall: Scorched by burning fire,
translations.en.yusufali: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
translations.id.indonesian: memasuki api yang sangat panas (neraka),

translations.en.sahih: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
translations.en.pickthall: Drinking from a boiling spring,
translations.en.yusufali: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
translations.id.indonesian: diberi minum (dengan air) dari sumber yang sangat panas.

arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
transliteration: Laisa lahum ta'aamun illaa min daree'

translations.en.sahih: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
translations.en.pickthall: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
translations.en.yusufali: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka tiada memperoleh makanan selain dari pohon yang berduri,

arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
transliteration: Laa yusminu wa laa yughnee min joo'

translations.en.sahih: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
translations.en.pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
translations.en.yusufali: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
translations.id.indonesian: yang tidak menggemukkan dan tidak pula menghilangkan lapar.

translations.en.sahih: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
translations.en.pickthall: In that day other faces will be calm,
translations.en.yusufali: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
translations.id.indonesian: Banyak muka pada hari itu berseri-seri,

translations.en.sahih: With their effort [they are] satisfied
translations.en.pickthall: Glad for their effort past,
translations.en.yusufali: Pleased with their striving,-
translations.id.indonesian: merasa senang karena usahanya,

translations.en.sahih: In an elevated garden,
translations.en.pickthall: In a high Garden
translations.en.yusufali: In a Garden on high,
translations.id.indonesian: dalam surga yang tinggi,

translations.en.sahih: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
translations.en.pickthall: Where they hear no idle speech,
translations.en.yusufali: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
translations.id.indonesian: tidak kamu dengar di dalamnya perkataan yang tidak berguna.

translations.en.sahih: Within it is a flowing spring.
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein is a gushing spring,
translations.en.yusufali: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalamnya ada mata air yang mengalir.

translations.en.sahih: Within it are couches raised high
translations.en.pickthall: Wherein are couches raised
translations.en.yusufali: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
translations.id.indonesian: Di dalamnya ada takhta-takhta yang ditinggikan,

translations.en.sahih: And cups put in place
translations.en.pickthall: And goblets set at hand
translations.en.yusufali: Goblets placed (ready),
translations.id.indonesian: dan gelas-gelas yang terletak (di dekatnya),

translations.en.sahih: And cushions lined up
translations.en.pickthall: And cushions ranged
translations.en.yusufali: And cushions set in rows,
translations.id.indonesian: dan bantal-bantal sandaran yang tersusun,

translations.en.sahih: And carpets spread around.
translations.en.pickthall: And silken carpets spread.
translations.en.yusufali: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
translations.id.indonesian: dan permadani-permadani yang terhampar.

arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

translations.en.sahih: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
translations.en.pickthall: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
translations.en.yusufali: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan unta bagaimana dia diciptakan,

translations.en.sahih: And at the sky - how it is raised?
translations.en.pickthall: And the heaven, how it is raised?
translations.en.yusufali: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan langit, bagaimana ia ditinggikan?

translations.en.sahih: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
translations.en.pickthall: And the hills, how they are set up?
translations.en.yusufali: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan gunung-gunung bagaimana ia ditegakkan?

translations.en.sahih: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
translations.en.pickthall: And the earth, how it is spread?
translations.en.yusufali: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan bumi bagaimana ia dihamparkan?

translations.en.sahih: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
translations.en.pickthall: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
translations.en.yusufali: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka berilah peringatan, karena sesungguhnya kamu hanyalah orang yang memberi peringatan.

translations.en.sahih: You are not over them a controller.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
translations.en.yusufali: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
translations.id.indonesian: Kamu bukanlah orang yang berkuasa atas mereka,

translations.en.sahih: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
translations.en.pickthall: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
translations.en.yusufali: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
translations.id.indonesian: tetapi orang yang berpaling dan kafir,

translations.en.sahih: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
translations.en.pickthall: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
translations.en.yusufali: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
translations.id.indonesian: maka Allah akan mengazabnya dengan azab yang besar.

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, to Us is their return.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
translations.en.yusufali: For to Us will be their return;
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya kepada Kami-lah kembali mereka,

translations.en.sahih: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
translations.en.pickthall: And Ours their reckoning.
translations.en.yusufali: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian sesungguhnya kewajiban Kami-lah menghisab mereka.
